mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, we are looking at clear skies and 30 degrees at Verona City Hall under a full moon.

City offices will be closed for the Thanksgiving holiday on November 26 and 27. Please note that refuse and recycling pickup is delayed until Friday, November 27, and the recycling center will be closed those two days.

There is plenty to do, starting with yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, or Paddy Mac's, plus live music at Paddy Mac's and pizza night at Lake Lou-ee.
In a recent report, officers handled a domestic disturbance on November 2 where a 48-year-old Verona man was arrested for battery and disorderly conduct.
The delicious flavor of the day is Butter Pecan. If you are craving a scoop, remember that the store opens today at 10:00 AM.
